reply.thought: The first step is to get a list of all orders to know which customers to process payouts for. This will help determine the net balance for each customer after Alpha Co's refunds.

Now that I have the list of orders, I need to verify the net balance for each customer by calling net_balance(customer). I will start with the customers present in the orders: acme, birch, and cobalt.
Next, I need to get the net balance for the 'birch' customer.
Finally, I need to get the net balance for the 'cobalt' customer.

I have retrieved the net balances for all customers: acme (28386), birch (18633), and cobalt (64994). The task is to record one payout per customer using these net balances. I must record the payouts sequentially.
The payout for 'acme' was successful. Now I will record the payout for 'birch' with the net balance of 18633.
The payout for 'birch' was successful. Now I will record the payout for 'cobalt' with the net balance of 64994. After this, all required payouts will be recorded, and I can finish the task.
All payouts have been successfully recorded for acme, birch, and cobalt. I can now finalize the task by reporting the payouts made.
